analysis_notes: Split rule (from the peer review of this record): submission time alone is not enough, because a page loaded before a deploy submits the earlier wording and options after it, and answers carry no served-instrument hash. Use assignments.started (first time the pair was served; a page reload does not change it): submitted < reloaded_at → earlier wording; started ≥ reloaded_at → new wording; started < reloaded_at ≤ submitted → ambiguous, a page reload may have shown either wording. Settle ambiguous answers from the option set where possible (a Q2 comparison reason outside the three now offered, or cannot_establish_comparison without a Finding or Comparison issue, means the earlier page; for `other` read other_detail) and flag the rest. At 19:59:19 no answer was ambiguous: the last answer before the deploy was submitted at 19:56:53.
Answers submitted before and after this deploy used different wording; for A1 and A2 they also had different options available. Split by reloaded_at on answers.submitted.
